title: Tanahashi vs. Okada: the struggle to become Ace
summary: Kazuchika Okada’s sudden rise challenges Tanahashi’s position at the top. Title exchanges and Dome defeats force the Rainmaker to prove that his first upset was the start of a new era.

chapters.title: Rainmaker Shock
chapters.result: Okada defeats Tanahashi for the IWGP heavyweight title.
chapters.context: A challenger recently returned from excursion topples the established Ace, immediately changing the championship hierarchy.

chapters.title: Tanahashi reclaims his place
chapters.result: Tanahashi defeats Okada to regain the title.
chapters.context: The veteran’s response makes the rivalry a continuing struggle for supremacy, not an instant succession.

chapters.title: Okada leaves the Dome in tears
chapters.result: Tanahashi defeats Okada to retain the championship.
chapters.context: Another loss on New Japan’s biggest stage leaves Okada unable to complete the generational takeover.

chapters.title: Okada finally wins their Dome main event
chapters.result: Okada defeats Tanahashi to retain the title.
chapters.context: The Rainmaker answers his previous Tokyo Dome failures, completing this chapter of the contest for New Japan’s leading position.
